name: consolidated-native-cleanup-build-window
objective: إزالة عناصر app-field DEPRECATED_CONFIRMED في نافذة Native coherent واحدة مع manifest/plugins/permissions وlocal verification ثم EAS build مخطط قدر الإمكان.
truthOwner: App-field native dependency graph, Expo config and platform permissions own build compatibility.
journeys: consolidated native removal and device verification

tasks.objective: Execute one evidence-gated app-field native cleanup set and prove resulting binary before closure.
tasks.currentProblem: Deprecated native packages remain intentionally installed until a safe build window; leaving them forever would violate final cleanup, while removing them piecemeal wastes builds and increases regression ambiguity.
tasks.requiredChange: Revalidate every confirmed removal, remove package/capability/plugin/permission/lockfile entries coherently, run local native/fingerprint/config checks, then one planned EAS build when necessary and full native regression.
tasks.targetState: Only required native capabilities remain in app-field binary/config, no deprecated confirmed package remains, and the rebuilt app passes device tests with minimized EAS cycles.
tasks.action: Freeze candidate, remove confirmed items only, generate config/fingerprint diff, run all local gates/native build, submit planned EAS build, install artifact and exercise every retained/affected native capability; restore classification and root-fix if any dependency was misjudged.
mustNotChange: لا تغيير dependencies لتطبيق آخر داخل الحزمة.
لا EAS build متكرر دون سبب جديد.
لا إخفاء failure بإعادة dependency بلا فهم owner.
acceptanceCriteria: كل confirmed removal أزيل مع capability/plugin/permission المقابلة.
local native verification يمر قبل cloud build عند توفره.
EAS artifact يعمل على الجهاز وجميع native journeys الحرجة تمر.
tasks.rollback: If a removal is disproven, classify it REQUIRED_NATIVE and restore coherently, then rebuild only after root evidence; never leave half-removed config.
tasks.commitBoundary: Single consolidated app-field native cleanup candidate before planned build.
